website_summary.name: Crypto Escrow Marketplace
website_summary.description: The website features a clean and modern design with a focus on facilitating secure cryptocurrency transactions between buyers and sellers.
website_summary.appearance: The website has a sleek and user-friendly interface with a light gray background and dark red components. The header includes a logo, the site title "Crypto Escrow," and user profiles for buyers and sellers. The main content area is divided into sections: a navigation panel on the left with options like "Products" and "Transactions," and a central area displaying available cryptocurrency products such as BTC Mining Rig, ETH Wallet Service, and LTC Trading Bot. Each product listing includes a title, description, price, and a "Purchase" button. The footer contains copyright information.
website_summary.functionality: The website allows users to browse and purchase cryptocurrency products. Buyers can select products, initiate transactions, and deposit cryptocurrencies into an escrow account. Sellers can manage their products and view transaction records. The site also supports transaction confirmation, cryptocurrency release, and dispute resolution. Users can navigate between different sections using the sidebar menu.

functionality_testing.coverage_element: Purchase for BTC Mining Rig Button
functionality_testing.preconditions: The website is open on the products page, the user is logged in if necessary.
